contract: Resident supplied bounded X/U/G/D rectangular gated MLP 64x64→128→64 on 4x4 PEs. Typed three-matmul/SiLU/multiply graph; forward aligned two-hop projections, explicit gate-left carry, joined task resources, SDK map/DSR gating, immutable inputs and last-use buffer reuse. No intermediate host transfer. Six SDK calls, exact target outputs; sampled mode additionally observes projection prefixes/gate/hidden/first operands, counter mode omits internal tensor observations. Corruption rejection, actual C++/device independent fsum/exp checks, matched adapted-source control and static ELF memory. No RMS/residual/full-model or hardware claim.
